Ever fired one?" <br /> "Many times." <br /> "Super. On behalf of the Taris Reconstruction Authority, welcome home.|The Cathar quartermaster and a Cathar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a '''quartermaster''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="DatingLogic">{{TOR_dates|1}} The conversation between the [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] and the [[Unidentified Cathar settler (Olaris)|settler]] is witnessed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players who visit their faction's version of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Republic classes visit Taris during Act I of their class stories, placing the conversation in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he was posted on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. On the behalf of the [[Taris Reconstruction Authority]], he greeted a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Unidentified Cathar settler (Olaris)|settler]] in the [[Olaris Spaceport]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The quartermaster first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as an ambient non-player character on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] with the nameplate "Tired Quartermaster".<ref name="TOR" />
